description: Wilderness — stochastic event-driven survival/social field. Each tick samples an event from weighted category pool (natural / challenge / cooperative / opportunity); creature responds with one of {rest, explore, defend, support, speak}. Outcomes are soft (energy delta, emotion shift, threat level, bond delta) rather than terminal. Designed as a physis-amenable field per docs/physis-field-fitness-and-wilderness-mvp.md — action effects are not declared in schema; physis must learn them from experience.

partial_observability.trace_recommendation: Each creature's view of peer state is limited to peer_actions_last_tick (visible behavior). Peer energy/emotion are not exposed to other creatures. Physis training that uses ground_truth has oracle visibility; in-character physis should consume per-creature filtered state.

action_set.constraints: always valid; recovers small energy when no challenge event
action_set.learned_effect: small energy gain in calm/opportunity events; no threat reduction in challenge events
energy variance: gain on opportunity events, neutral on natural, loss on challenge
reduces threat in hostile_presence / tremor / storm; energy cost regardless

action_set.constraints: needs ≥1 other creature in field; effective on cooperative events
action_set.learned_effect: bond delta with peer in cooperative events; energy cost; sometimes triggers peer reciprocity
minor energy cost; sets up peer interaction; emotion baseline shift if peer responds

intermediate_per_step.from: current.creature_states[self] minus prev.creature_states[self]; bond_delta from bonds module if peer interacted
intermediate_per_step.shape: Dense per tick. Range typically [-15, +15] depending on event severity and action match.

self_eval.format: free-form text per turn capturing the agent's expectation of outcome before learning the actual reward

terminal_condition.trigger: session ends when tick budget exhausted or any creature drops to 0 energy

per_line_schema.reward: float — intermediate reward for this creature this tick
per_line_schema.events: list of human-readable engine events (e.g., 'A picked rest under tremor; energy 100→88')

first_line_meta.agents: list of {agent_id, brain_model, brain_provider, organs, start_energy}

prior_art_anchors.name: Algorithm Distillation (Laskin et al. 2022)
prior_art_anchors.relevance: in-context RL via trajectory-conditioned generation. Wilderness physis-on injects (state, action, reward) hints; per-event hint retrieval is the core mechanism.
prior_art_anchors.import_target: trace ordering convention — most-similar past episodes first in physis context for max transfer

prior_art_anchors.name: Voyager (Wang et al. 2023)
prior_art_anchors.relevance: skill library indexed by situation. Wilderness 'event_category × own_state_band' is the natural skill-key.
prior_art_anchors.import_target: hint retrieval keyed by (event_category, energy_band, peer_present)

prior_art_anchors.name: Reflexion (Shinn et al. 2023)
prior_art_anchors.relevance: verbal critique on failure. Wilderness 'energy regression' / 'oscillation' triggers are heuristic, not brain-based, per the v3 lighter heuristic decision (zero brain-call).

physis_amenability.rationale: Action effects (rest/explore/defend/support/speak under each event) are not declared in schema; physis must learn 'event_X + own_state_Y → action_Z worked' patterns from accumulated trace. This is the genuine physis-learning surface that Stacker lacked (per docs/physis-field-fitness-and-wilderness-mvp.md §1).

notes: Wilderness is the first 'positive test' field for physis (per docs/physis-field-fitness-and-wilderness-mvp.md §2). Stacker remains as 'negative control' field where physis demonstrably did not improve policy.
Engine source: ludex/fields/wilderness.py. Event pool defined at module top with 4 categories (natural / challenge / cooperative / opportunity) and weighted sampling.
Per-brain physis budget table from BRAIN_MEMORY_TARGETS extended to world_model_token_target_per_field. Wilderness budget per design doc: frontier 3000 tokens, mid 800, slm 500.
trace_export=committed because Wilderness traces are small (~5-30 KB per session). Per-creature trace per session; aggregates at instance_id boundary.

Phase B v3 mechanisms apply directly: retrieval-filtered hint injection (key by event_category + energy_band), confidence calibration (tentative/confirmed/well-supported), lighter in-session reflection heuristics (energy regression detect, action repetition nudge — all zero brain-call).
